0022600181.text: The Timberwolves, 5-3 and third in the Northwest, are the road team in their ninth game of the season against the Houston Rockets, who are 7-1, first in the Southwest and first in the West, and riding a two-game win streak. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. Houston is without Clint Capela (out, ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 136-132 win in Houston on April 10, 2026.
